name: HotpotQA
description: HotpotQA is a multi-hop question answering dataset requiring models to reason over multiple Wikipedia passages to answer questions. It contains two types of questions: bridge questions (connecting two entities via a chain) and comparison questions (comparing attributes of two entities). Also includes supporting fact identification as a secondary task.
reputation: Foundational multi-hop QA benchmark; introduced multi-hop reasoning evaluation; widely used for testing chain-of-thought and retrieval-augmented generation systems
notes: Introduced at EMNLP 2018. Contains ~113K question-answer pairs. Two settings: distractor (10 paragraphs provided, 8 distractors) and fullwiki (must retrieve from all Wikipedia). Bridge questions involve two hops; comparison questions compare attributes. Crucial benchmark for evaluating multi-hop reasoning and retrieval-augmented generation.
